name: Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact
summary: Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is a specialty solvent free, ready to use non porous primer designed for use over smooth and non-porous surfaces and substrates.

items.label: SUSTAINABILITY
items.text:
Product characteristic and benefits:
Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is a solvent-free, single-component non-porous primer engineered to deliver superior adhesion on sound, smooth, and non-absorbent substrates. Formulated with post-consumer recycled materials and incorporating patent-pending technology, this environmentally responsible primer boasts exceptionally low VOC emissions, positioning it as a sustainable solution for both interior and exterior applications.
Sika customers benefit from:
A sustainable solution that supports reducing our carbon footprint.
Refer to the sustainability Factsheet for more information.

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text: Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact Patent Pending.

items.label: Recycled content
items.text: Up to 15% recycled raw material content.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 12 months from date of manufacture if unopened.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text:
Store in dry cool conditions out of direct sunlight.
Do not allow the product to freeze.

items.label: System structure
items.text:
Non-porous System | Moisture/Vapour Barrier System
Clean non-porous surface | Concrete subfloor up to 98% RH (2 coats)
Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact | Sikalastic Moisture Seal or Sikafloor 158W Fast Barrier (2 coats)
Subsequent suitable Sika product | Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact Subsequent suitable Sika product

items.label: Substrates
items.text:
Ceramic and porcelain tiles
Terazzo*
PVC and Metal control leak flanges and pipe penetrations prior to waterproofing
Non-porous coatings*
Acrylic membranes*
Non-porous construction sheeting and boards*
*Note: conduct a bond test prior to priming application to verify suitability

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text:
Before applying subsequent flooring products Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact must be completely dry (50min+ @ 23°C). Do not install products over wet or pooling Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact, Instead, brush the pooling product out and wait till dry. When priming resin backed stone allow primer to dry for 3 hours (at 23°C & 50% RH).
In cool or cold climate drying time will be extended.

items.label: Consumption
items.text: 8-10m2 per lite dependant on substrate texture and profile.

items.label: EQUIPMENT
items.text: Paint brush or medium nap roller

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
The substrate must have adequate strength, load bearing capacity, dimensional stability and be dry. All substratss must be clean, dry and free of residues which reduce adhesion, e.g. dust, dirt, oil, grease, wax, cleaning agents and loose particles. 100% solids epoxy must be applied more than 24hrs before Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact can be applied.
When applying over exisiting tiles ensure the tiles are well bonded. Glossy tiles should be sanded to remove the gloss finish. When installing over old flooring/coatings Sika® recommends mechanical abrasion (sanding/grinding) be carried out to achieve fresh non-contaminated surface, with coating having a minimum pull off strength of 1.5MPa. This is to be followed by a thorough clean prior to installing Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact & subsequent Sika® products.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is premixed, however stirring the product prior to use is recommeded.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: Apply a single coat with a paint brush or medium nap paint roller or paint brush to provide a continuous coating to the substrate. Allow primer to dry and harden prior to flooring, levelling, tiling or subsequent coatings.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text:
Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water prior to the material drying.
Dried product shall require mechanical removal.
